The '''GN-40 twin rotating blaster cannon''' was an [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] manufactured by [[Borstel Galactic Defense/Legends|Borstel]]. [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] was equipped with two such cannons.<ref name="SWCCS_p141" /><ref name="Complete Vehicles" />
